statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-0994 (GHSA-7gcm-g887-7qv7): google.protobuf.json_format.ParseDict() in the Python protobuf library does not count nested google.protobuf.Any messages against max_recursion_depth, so deeply nested Any values in untrusted JSON bypass the limit and exhaust the Python stack (https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/issues/25070, https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/pull/25239). PyPI protobuf before 5.29.6, and 6.30.0rc1 to 6.33.4, is affected (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-7gcm-g887-7qv7). The upstream fix changes the Python module python/google/protobuf/json_format.py and its test. DHI protobuf for Alpine 3.23 is built from Alpine's protobuf package recipe, which builds the C++ libraries and the compiler and no Python bindings; its one published build, 31.1-r1, has the subpackages protobuf, libprotobuf, libprotobuf-lite, libprotoc, protoc, protobuf-dev and protobuf-vim. Unpacked all of them for x86_64 and aarch64: they hold musl-linked shared libraries (libprotobuf, libprotobuf-lite, libprotoc, libutf8_range, libutf8_validity), the protoc, protoc-gen-upb and protoc-gen-upbdefs programs, a static libupb.a, C++ headers, the .proto definitions of the well-known types, CMake and pkg-config files and a vim syntax file. None contains a Python file or the json_format module; the Python protobuf library is not part of this owner.

statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-0994 (GHSA-7gcm-g887-7qv7): google.protobuf.json_format.ParseDict() in the Python protobuf library does not count nested google.protobuf.Any messages against max_recursion_depth, so deeply nested Any values in untrusted JSON bypass the limit and exhaust the Python stack (https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/issues/25070, https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/pull/25239). PyPI protobuf before 5.29.6, and 6.30.0rc1 to 6.33.4, is affected (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-7gcm-g887-7qv7). Debian fixed it for trixie in protobuf 3.21.12-11+deb13u1, whose changelog reads "Fix CVE-2026-0994: JSON recursion depth bypass (closes: #1126302)" (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-0994). The DHI protobuf packages for Debian 13 are rebuilds of Debian's trixie protobuf, and the only protobuf version now published in the DHI Debian repository is a rebuild of Debian's 3.21.12-11+deb13u1 security update (libprotobuf32t64, libprotobuf-lite32t64, libprotoc32t64, protobuf-compiler and python3-protobuf with their -dbgsym packages, plus libprotobuf-dev and libprotoc-dev, for amd64 and arm64). We checked that build against the index checksum on amd64 and arm64: its package changelog carries Debian's entry for this CVE, and the json_format.py in its python3-protobuf package converts nested well-known types inside an Any through ConvertMessage(), so each nested Any message counts against max_recursion_depth, as in the upstream fix. Every published build carries the fix, so the range ends at that build.
